notes.title: Animal Shelter 2 - Release Date is here!
notes.notes:
Animal Lovers! 🎊

Finally, after all this time we're incredibly excited to announce something that you waited for a long time! 🔥

Throughout the first Playtest, Demo, Prologue, hard work of our team, polishing, implementing months of your feedback, requests, ideas and now we have a game that is ready for the launch! 🤩

🗓️ The release date for Animal Shelter 2 is:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/59d7388851d96335adde38364adee1a66f9fe5eb.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2658510/Animal_Shelter_2/
[previewyoutube=Ar1GdZdh0ck;full][/previewyoutube]

Those were crazy 537 DAYS since our announcement of the game and not a single one of those days would be meaningful without you 🫵 You gave us so much and and now we're ready to give all the love back to you! 😻

Yeah, the release is not that far, and we can't wait to show you what we have prepared for you in the full version of the game! ☺️

We worked hard to get closer and closer to something you will trully love. This date is a significant monument for us, the proof of what we created, which is a an amazing experience for you to enjoy the game. 🐱 🐶


Donations, Challenges and Contests! 🏆
Get ready for the coming days... 👀 We have some interesting activities for you to enjoy while you wait for the premiere! 🤭

The first challenge is the Community Group Challenge! 😻 

Make sure to check out the entry below to learn more 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2658510/view/546739082808525241

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/04aaee60c314cb7eba5ee7af51639e5cfb0ab764.png

See you soon!
Animal Shelter 2 Team

notes.title: Exciting News - Animal Shelter 2: Prologue Release Date Set!
notes.notes:
Get ready Animal Lovers! 😻

The next BIG step in the development of Animal Shelter 2 will start next week!

On September 13th at 5:00 PM CEST you will be able to play the free Prologue for Animal Shelter 2! 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2887780/Animal_Shelter_2_Prologue/

But that's not all... Let your friends know to save time next week because the Prologue will be fully available in CO-OP mode! 🤯

🗓️ Mark your calendars and prepare to experience the new features and improvements firsthand - SEPTEMBER 13, 2024 at 5:00 PM CEST

In the meantime, while we wait for the premiere of the Prologue, check out the latest trailer below, showing the progress of changes from Animal Shelter 1 to the release of the Prologue for Animal Shelter 2

[previewyoutube=u1Azx7_YBlE;full][/previewyoutube]
That's not all... 👀 we have prepared for you in the coming days - we would also like to present to you a list of key changes that have occurred since the development of Animal Shelter 2: Prologue, so stay tuned!


Hop on over to Discord to chat with us and other members of our community! 👇
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/71bc1a3f390b736c7d108102b6e05e4572bced4f.png 

See you soon,
Animal Shelter 2 Team

notes.title: ANIMAL SHELTER OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE SET!
notes.notes:
HELLO ANIMAL LOVERS! 🐱 🐶

Animal Shelter will be released on:
MARCH 23, 2022

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239320/Animal_Shelter/

That's right, the wait is almost over! Get ready to save and take care of our four-legged friends! 🐕‍🦺🐈

We realize that many of you have been eagerly waiting to play the game. After the demo, prologue, playtest finally everyone will be able to play the game! The entire team is really delighted that you will be able to play the full version of the game in the second half of march. 

COMMUNITY CHALLENGE
On the occasion of the game's premiere, we also decided to organize a Community Challenge in which you will be able to participate. Just press picture below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40741420/c648eb7445dd75a1336bd4de97d9cf4787e8c0d5.png

We hope that reading about this news makes you as excited as it makes us! This is the final countdown!

[previewyoutube=uZSTfiitixE;full][/previewyoutube]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

We are back to work, see you soon! Remember we are launching on March 23, 2022 - we are almost there!


Best regards,
Animal Shelter Team

notes.title: MAIN CHANGES IN TERMS OF THE DEMO
notes.notes:
Hello, Fans! 🐶 😺 

We listened to your suggestions (we really read ALL comments😎) and the biggest changes between demo and prologue, we added:


 Shelter expansion mode (buying, rearranging and furnishing the buildings and the shelter area)
 Possibility to buy additional land
 Choosing and receiving animals
 Extensive adoption summary panel
 More missions and the ability to adopt a dog and a cat in one game
 Different breeds of dogs/cats (there was only one dog and one cat in the demo)
 New animal behavior (ex. playing with each other)
 Improved inventory
 Encyclopedia
 A saved game has been added
 Reputation system and taking into account the needs of new pet owners
 Even more polished graphic style

These are just some changes compared to the demo version. The prologue will contain much more expanded gameplay and more features, and most importantly, it will allow for longer gameplay. Make sure to leave us a comment if you are also excited! 🤩


Don't miss the launch and add it to your Steam wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1661260/Animal_Shelter_Prologue/
